source: RI-CRM01 §1, transcribed verbatim. All values in gold.

decay.rule: Bounty NEVER decays with time. Cleared only by paying, serving, an expiation quest, or a faction (RI-CRM02 §6).
decay.why: A decaying bounty makes the optimal response to every crime walking into the wilderness for a while, which is not a consequence, it is a loading screen.

crimes.name: Trespass, reported
crimes.note: Only from ALARM, never from CHALLENGE (RI-STL02 §4)

crimes.name: Theft
crimes.note: Uncapped in value_g; the 11 tier-5 items run 800-3,400 g

crimes.name: Assault - a blow landed on a non-hostile
Murder - named NPC
crimes.note: S5: named NPCs never respawn. This is permanent.

crimes.name: Murder - a witness mid-report
crimes.note: The S10 clause. The suppressed bounty is applied at x2 IF the killing is witnessed. See RI-CRM01 §3c.

crimes.name: Resisting arrest
crimes.note: Added to the existing bounty, not replacing it

crimes.name: Cutting a sapwell without a rootkeeper
crimes.note: The only crime that is a crime in BOTH legal systems (RI-LOR05 §4b)

crimes.name: Freeing a legally-held slave (Dres charter)
crimes.note: And it is the right thing to do, and the game says so through other characters

jurisdictions.enforces: Legion and settlement militia; the schedule above
jurisdictions.rumour_effect: your name appears in every settlement's rumour pool

jurisdictions.note: No bounty. No guards. No jail.

jurisdiction_rule: Crossing from one jurisdiction to another does not clear anything, and a guard in Gideon does not care what you did in Thorn - but the rumour travels.

partial_report.note: An unidentified or hearing-only witness produces bounty at x0.4, attributed to nobody. Being SUSPECTED and being WANTED are different states and the game must have both.

cleared_by: the family's extinction (which creates a new blood-price with whoever is left)
